audioVariants.label: 当前克隆版
audioVariants.description: 现有中文 POC 音频；句子时间为按中文字数估算，用作基线对照。
audioVariants.descriptionEn: Existing Chinese POC audio with text-length-estimated cue timing; retained as the baseline.

audioVariants.label: 整句自然语速（30.43 秒）
audioVariants.description: 当前推荐校对版：每个完整中文句子只合成一次，不在句内拼接，不调整句内语速；仅保留英文句间停顿。比英文窗口短约 10.45 秒，尚未达到同步门线。
audioVariants.descriptionEn: Current review default: one synthesis per complete Chinese sentence, no internal splice or pace change, with English inter-sentence pauses. About 10.45s shorter than the English window; sync gate not met.

cues.text: 看似失败的事，其实是耶稣在战胜我们的仇敌，因为他是那位胜过一切的。
cues.source: What looked to be like a loss was Jesus really conquering our enemy, because he’s the one who conquers over everything.

cues.text: 他胜过一切。
cues.source: He conquers over everything.

cues.text: 你有一个仇敌，是一头吼叫的狮子。
cues.source: You have an enemy who is a roaring lion.

cues.text: 正伺机毁灭你，吞吃你。
cues.source: Who's seeking to destroy you and devour you.

cues.text: 但下周我们讲到《启示录》第4章和第5章时，就会看到耶稣被称为犹大支派的狮子，
cues.source: But we're going to see next week when we get to Revelation chapter 4 and 5 that Jesus is called the Lion of the tribe of Judah,

cues.text: 而他的吼声压倒了撒但的吼声。
cues.source: and His roar overwhelms Satan's roar.
